title: Product classes span total tensor homology over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $A,B$ be integer-indexed cochain complexes of $k$-vector spaces whose terms vanish below some integer. Set $T=\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_k B)$ with direct-sum terms and differential $d_A\otimes 1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_B$. For every integer $n$, $H^n(T)$ is spanned over $k$ by classes $[z]$ where $z$ is a total cycle whose inclusion is the summand tensor $a\otimes b$ for some cycles $a\in Z^p(A)$ and $b\in Z^q(B)$ with $p+q=n$.

proof.text: Every vector space is projective and injective over a field by semisimplicity. Split each homology quotient by Projective.factorThru and extend it to full terms by Injective.factorThru. Their composite defines a cochain endomorphism e whose values lie in cycles and whose induced homology maps are identities.
Apply the split-category null-homotopy theorem to e-id, whose homology maps vanish. Thus e is homotopic to id, for each factor complex.

Tensor the two endomorphisms using mapBifunctorMap. Mathlib mapBifunctorMapHomotopy₁ and mapBifunctorMapHomotopy₂ give a homotopy to the identity of the total complex, so its homology map is the identity. Each tensor of its output factors is a tensor of cycles; the total outgoing differential therefore vanishes. Lift this map to total cycles.

Let V be the span of product cycle classes. The composite from the total degree-n term through the lifted cycle map, the homology quotient, and the quotient by V vanishes: check each summand on pure tensors, where its image belongs to the generating set by construction. Homology naturality and the identity action on homology then show that the composite of the homology projection with the quotient by V vanishes. Since the homology projection is surjective, every homology class lies in V. All arguments use finite-support colimits and adjacent differentials; no lower bound or dimension hypothesis is required.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_homology_product_span {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (A B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} k) ℤ)
    (hA : ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p < m → IsZero (A.X p))
    (hB : ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < m → IsZero (B.X q)) (n : ℤ) :
    Submodule.span k {x | ∃ (s : {pq : ℤ × ℤ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
        (a : A.cycles s.1.1) (b : B.cycles s.1.2)
        (z : (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).cycles n),
        (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).iCycles n z =
          ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
            s.1.1 s.1.2 n s.2
            ((A.iCycles s.1.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles s.1.2 b)) ∧
        x = (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homologyπ n z} = ⊤
